signals.text: Tights are a must in my life.  Nice and toasty.  I attribute them to keeping me alive in the winter.  Thanks.  I love ‘em.

My 20 year old daughter wanted some tights to wear under her skirts for the cooler weather. These are pretty good. They have a decent stretch to them. She says the fit is good and as expected. They are comfortable to wear.  They do give a little more warmth than exposed legs.
